{{Quote|What do you feel?''"<br />"''That nexus.| Luke Skywalker and Jaina Solo, on sensing the nexus that powered the statues|<ref name="FotJ" />}}
'''Unidentified Sith statues''' guarded the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] around and inside the [[Dark Force Temple]],<ref name="MOTS" /> once under control of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]],<ref name="DFS" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="MOTS" /> Motionless, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] statues resembled cloaked figures, holding a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] pommel. Empowered by the dark [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Vergence/Legends|nexus]] in the temple,<ref name="FotJ" /> the statues blocked or harmed unwanted visitors.<ref name="MOTS" /> While some were placed decoratively in [[Color/Legends|gold]],<ref name="FotJ" /> other grey [[Stone/Legends|stone]] statues populated the area and eternally watched their grounds with glowing red eyes. As a test for one's Force sensitivity, a way to pass through their traps was the use of [[Mind trick/Legends|Force Persuasion]].<ref name="MOTS" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, we can deduce that ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> [[Reciprocal apprenticeship|reciprocally training]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and [[Kyle Katarn]] encountered the statues during their [[Mission to Dromund Kaas (New Republic)|trials]] on Dromund Kaas.<ref name="MOTS" /> By [[44 ABY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Jedi [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and [[Sith Saber]] [[Vestara Khai]] journeyed to the temple in search of the Force entity [[Abeloth]] and faced two looming gold statues outside of the temple.<ref name="FotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith statues first appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' outside of the Dark Force Temple in the twelth level of the game.<ref name="MOTS" />
